description: National holidays (hari libur nasional) and cuti bersama per year, one row per day, from the SKB 3 Menteri (Menteri Agama, Menteri Ketenagakerjaan, Menteri PANRB). National layer of the calendars (F-025): it wins over provincial estimates.
status: ready for 2026 and 2027 (the SKB 2028 is expected around September 2027)
source: SKB Nomor 1497, 2, 5 Tahun 2025 (year 2026, signed 2025-09-19) and SKB Nomor 1205, 3, 2 Tahun 2026 (year 2027, signed 2026-09-15), published by Kemenko PMK (www.kemenkopmk.go.id); raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/libur-nasional/
procedure: The PDFs are scans; their Lampiran A and B were transcribed by hand into tools/converters/libur-nasional.py, which checks every printed weekday against its date and writes libur-nasional.json. Version = signing date of the newest SKB.

fields.weekday: weekday as printed in the SKB (checked)
fields.label: keterangan as printed in the SKB
fields.ref: Lampiran A (libur nasional) or B (cuti bersama) row number
fields.set_by_minister_of_religion: true for Idul Fitri and Idul Adha: the final date follows the Minister of Religious Affairs' decree (KEDUA)
